children: Capital Southwest completed a $350 million public offering of 6.750% unsecured notes due 2031, priced at 98.985% of par for net proceeds of approximately $342.1 million. The company intends to use the proceeds to repay a portion of its senior secured revolving credit facility, enhancing liquidity and extending its debt maturity profile. Interest will be paid semi-annually beginning March 15, 2027, and the notes are redeemable at par plus a make-whole premium before August 15, 2031, and at par thereafter. The offering was executed under an underwriting agreement led by Deutsche Bank Securities and supported by other major banks, and the note terms were set under an eighth supplemental indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee.
